Package nzilbb.ag.automation

Class LabelBasedTagger

  • java.lang.Object
    • nzilbb.ag.automation.Annotator
      • nzilbb.ag.automation.LabelBasedTagger
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Function<Graph,​Graph>, UnaryOperator<Graph>, GraphTransformer, MonitorableTask
    public abstract class LabelBasedTagger
extends Annotator
    Base class for annotators that tag tokens based (almost) exclusively on the labels from a specific input layer, not on context.

    This provides common implementation for taggers that perform simple lexical lookups for tagging words with their pronunciations, etc. and also those which generate pronunciations (or other tags) based on spelling.

    The intention is that the derived class can provide a single method (tagsFor(String)) that maps an input label (e.g. orthography) to one or more output labels (e.g. pronunciations), and the rest of the processing (identification of tokens, filtering by language, mass updates) is handled by this base class in an efficient and standardized way. Then this base class's implementations of GraphTransformer.transform(Graph), transformTranscripts(GraphStore,String), Annotator.transformFragments(Stream,Consumer), and tagAllInstances(GraphStore,String) will handle the annotation details.

    Implementations that require language filtering - i.e. only tagging tokens in a specific language - need to ensure that targetLanguagePattern is set to identify which language, along with transcriptLanguageLayerId to specify a transcript attribute that identifies the language of the transcript as a whole, and phraseLanguageLayerId to identify a layer where phrase-specific language annotations might be present.

      • transformTranscripts

        public void transformTranscripts​(GraphStore store,
                                 String expression)
                          throws TransformationException,
                                 InvalidConfigurationException,
                                 StoreException,
                                 PermissionException
        Transforms all graphs from the given graph store that match the given graph expression.

        This implementation uses GraphStoreQuery.aggregateMatchingAnnotations(String,String) and GraphStore.tagMatchingAnnotations​(String,String,String,Integer) to optimize tagging transcripts en-masse.

        Overrides:
        transformTranscripts in class Annotator
        Parameters:
        store - The graph to store.
        expression - An expression for identifying transcripts to update, or null to transform all transcripts in the store.
        Throws:
        TransformationException - If the transformation cannot be completed.
        InvalidConfigurationException - If Annotator.setTaskParameters(String) or Annotator.setSchema(Schema) have not yet been called.
        StoreException - If one of the store methods throws this exception.
        PermissionException - If one of the store methods throws this exception.
